deck_title: Box-Muller polar log-radical 2D Gaussian sampling vs naive uniform-disk tail starvation rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic George E. P. Box & Mervin E. Muller (1958) polar log-radical 2D Gaussian importance sampling (r(u) = sigma * sqrt(-2 * ln(1 - u)), where radial area stretch 1/(1-u) cancels Gaussian decay (1-u) to lock probability-mass Jacobian J = 1.0000x across 17 quantile stations u in [0.00, 0.80]) versus naive uniform-area disk sampling (d(r^2)/du = const, where unstretched probability mass drops as 1 - u to 0.8000x at u=0.20, 0.5000x at median u=0.50, and 0.2000x at u=0.80 across 16/17 stations) and 64-subring 2D polar Gaussian annulus quadrature.
